description_for_human: Free engineering platform for embedded systems, home repair, university-level courses, and product reviews.
description_for_model: TechPulse publishes deep technical tutorials on embedded systems (ESP32, Arduino, STM32), IoT firmware, home automation, home repair, and programming. It also provides 24 free university-level engineering courses (MIT, Stanford, Berkeley, CMU) with lectures, assignments, and step-by-step solutions. Content is available in English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, French, and Portuguese.
